clips.title: The story
paras: Thundris Windweaver gives an Empty Sampling Tube in Auberdine to gather water from the Cliffspring River. Night elf scholars study the taint threatening Darkshore.

Darkshore's waterways are turning foul as blight spreads through the wilderness. Thundris Windweaver, an investigator in Auberdine, gives you an empty glass tube to collect water from the Cliffspring River. Take the sample from the pool beneath the first waterfall north of town. Night elf naturalists examine it to learn about the corruption flowing toward Mist's Edge.
